title: Gift ideas
audience: For anyone who hears the perfect gift idea in March and forgets it by December.
description: A gift idea list your AI fills as you go: ideas by person, sizes and likes, and suggestions before the next birthday.
note:
Gift ideas

Save ideas the moment you hear them, so the next birthday is easy.

## Sizes and likes

prompt.default: Use my Amber Notes note "Gift ideas". Whenever I mention something someone would like, add a row with log_table_row: Person, Occasion if I said one, Idea, Budget as a number if I gave one, and Status Idea. Keep what I learn about each person (sizes, favourite things, what they already have) under "Sizes and likes" with append_to_note. Before a birthday, when I ask, read the note and suggest three gifts within budget that fit what's there. When I buy one, set its Status to Bought with edit_note.

asks: Maja mentioned she wants a good chef's knife.
Dad's birthday is in three weeks. Ideas under 500?
Jonas wears a medium and loves anything green.

args.text:
- **Maja:** cooks a lot, already has a stand mixer.
- **Jonas:** medium, loves anything green.
